$comment: Copy to config/models.json (gitignored), or let scripts/use-models.sh <profile> write it. Keep the providers you have keys for and pick agents.primaryModel / agents.fallbackModel as '<provider name>/<model name>' from different providers. Keys are read from the environment variables named in apiKeyEnv and never stored in this file. Default profile nvidia-free (free tiers only, $0): primary NVIDIA API Catalog nvidia/nemotron-3-ultra-550b-a55b, fallback the same model on OpenRouter's free tier (nvidia/nemotron-3-ultra-550b-a55b:free: a different provider, key and quota, large enough for Task B); Groq qwen/qwen3.8-27b stays configured as a spare (its free tier allows 7,000 input tokens per minute, too few for Task B). The other providers are untested alternatives; check model ids against your account (GET <baseUrl>/models). Switching models is a config change plus `node scripts/setup-trueforge.mjs`, or `scripts/use-models.sh <profile>`.

nvidia-free.note: Default. NVIDIA API Catalog free tier; fallback OpenRouter free tier (same model, separate key and quota).

openrouter-free.note: If NVIDIA throttles (429). OpenRouter free tier as primary, NVIDIA as fallback. OpenRouter caps free-model requests per day.

openrouter-paid.note: PAID: needs OpenRouter credit. qwen/qwen3-coder-next primary, NVIDIA free tier fallback. Requires --paid-ok.
